actions.expected: exit 0; TAP summary fail=0 with pass>0; test point matching E03 (V_E03 or bare id) is ok
TAP evidence is persisted to disk and parseable with effective executions > 0
candidate digest is recorded in the verdict (observation only; does not gate)

verdictSemantics.PASS: actions executed with execution count > 0 and every expected outcome met
verdictSemantics.FAIL: the scenario executed and the observed outcome contradicted the frozen THEN
verdictSemantics.NOT-EXERCISED: a prerequisite was missing (case definition, registered baseline, identity or environment); structured refusal, nonzero exit, never a pass
verdictSemantics.NOT-APPLICABLE: explicitly out of scope for the registered profile with a recorded reason; still nonzero
